description:
List recent SMS messages received on your JoltSMS numbers.

Returns sender, body, parsed OTP code (if detected), and timestamps.
Use number_id to filter to a specific number, or omit for all numbers.
Use from_filter for exact-match sender filtering.

from_filter.description: Filter by sender phone number (exact match, e.g. "+18005551234")

number_id.description: Filter by number ID (UUID) or phone number (e.g. +17243213654 or 7243213654). Omit for all numbers.

since.description: ISO 8601 datetime — only return messages after this time. Example: "2025-01-15T00:00:00Z"

name: joltsms_list_messages
